GUI.note: Root of the GUI document. Static and self-contained: the GUI can boot from this alone, with no runtime attached. A connected .me kernel resolves it (values, visibility, authorization); it does not replace it.

bars.note: The edge bars around the content area. All five are part of the document; which ones are on is resolved at runtime from what the app configures.

sticky.note: Sticky options strip under the top bar.

content.note: Where the current page renders. Each child is a page: `component` names the React component that implements it (looked up in the registry the app passes to renderGuiDocumentPage), `route` is where it is served.

landing.note: Landing: the .me QR and the sign-in / register / recover forms. Behavior (forms, session, Beatle) stays in the component; the document only says the page exists, where it lives and what implements it.
